propositions: The system must express which LLM model to use for each capability tier (frontier, standard, trivial) via config slots that accept model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array.

Config slots must be parseable from the layered precedence chain (CLI > env vars > config file > defaults) with per-field env vars (REBAR_LLM_*_MODEL/PROVIDER/ENDPOINT) that override only their specific field, leaving sibling fields intact.
The resolver must map class names to provider-qualified model strings, inferring the provider via infer_provider when omitted, and preserving bare-id resolution behavior for backward compatibility.

Fallback entries must conform to the slot schema minus the fallback key itself (model required, provider optional, endpoint optional, api_key forbidden), must be non-recursive, and must parse and carry on the resolved record without runtime consumption.

The parser must be reachable from real configuration via load_class_slots() in model_classes.py, which reads model_classes from the merged [tool.rebar.llm] table and degrades gracefully to defaults when the table is absent.
Secrets (api_key) must be rejected in both class slots and fallback entries, and nested or cyclic fallback chains must be rejected with typed config errors.
